source_contract.domain_selection: select source_nodes whose frozen domain identity is Domain V, preserving exact source order and identity

batching.rule: No frozen source node may be omitted, duplicated, renamed, reordered, or migrated. Candidate topology remains Learning-owner provisional unless stronger source or human authority is separately observed.

candidate_requirements.subskills: Each requirement receives one bounded assessable capability statement, exact frozen parent binding, Learning-owner provisional derivation class, evidence references and a matching decomposition edge.
candidate_requirements.prerequisite_edges: Do not infer hard dependencies from adjacency. Preserve uncertain relationships as UNRESOLVED__NOT_CANONICAL unless explicit evidence supports admission.
candidate_requirements.acyclicity: Every cumulative candidate must remain acyclic and endpoint-resolvable under Validator 003.

successor_instruction: Materialize exact frozen Domain V nodes V.A.1, V.A.2, V.B.1, V.C.1 and V.C.2; add evidence-bound provisional subskills/decomposition; preserve uncertain dependencies explicitly; validate cumulatively against completed Domains I-IV with unchanged Validator 003; then continue final Domain V Batch 02.
stop_condition: All six frozen Domain V requirements have truthful source-order dispositions across two hosted-validated batches and the next Domain VI successor is selected without replaying prior domains.
